J,

Thanks for the clear list. We're attaching a snapshot from our authenticated internal scanner (vm_scan_snapshot_20261110.pdf) and a working patch manifest for the single outstanding critical CVE in your inventory (patch_manifest_CVE-2026-1471.csv). High level commitments below — I'll put Monica (Dir. Security) on the attestation once she signs off.

Quick summary: 
- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated scans (internal), nightly lightweight discovery, monthly external authenticated scan. Quarterly third-party pen test.
- Remediation SLAs (standard): critical = 7 calendar days from triage, high = 30 days, medium = 90 days.
- Exceptions: We operate an exception lane for legacy embedded devices; exceptions are documented in JIRA-REQ-8842 and require CTO + Security approval and compensating control documentation.
- Retention: scan artifacts retained for 13 months (raw results + parsed metadata) and 36 months for SOC-related evidence exports.

Attachments: vm_scan_snapshot_20261110.pdf; patch_manifest_CVE-2026-1471.csv; vm_retention_policy_2026-11.txt

Are those SLAs acceptable for your SOC package? If you need a formal attestation letter, Monica can provide a signed statement tomorrow.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Infra Ops (on behalf of Vulnerability Ops)
Redwood Inference
